tools.name: routific_optimize_routes
tools.description: Plan the fastest routes for a fleet that serves a set of stops, with time windows and capacity. Synchronous; times out after about 20 seconds, so use routific_submit_route_job above 60 visits. Routific API: POST /v1/vrp.

tools.name: routific_submit_route_job
tools.description: Start a route plan for a large problem (up to 2500 visits) as a background job. Returns a job_id; read it with routific_get_job. Routific API: POST /v1/vrp-long.

tools.name: routific_optimize_pickups_deliveries
tools.description: Plan same-day pickup and delivery routes: each order is picked up before it is dropped off by the same driver. Synchronous; use routific_submit_pickups_deliveries_job above 30 orders. Routific API: POST /v1/pdp.

tools.name: routific_submit_pickups_deliveries_job
tools.description: Start a same-day pickup and delivery plan for a large problem as a background job. Returns a job_id; read it with routific_get_job. Routific API: POST /v1/pdp-long.

tools.name: routific_get_job
tools.description: Read a background route job by job_id. Status is pending, processing, finished or error; a finished job's route plan is in output. Routific API: GET /jobs/{id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: routific_submit_route_job, routific_submit_pickups_deliveries_job · Public sink: routific_optimize_routes, routific_submit_route_job, routific_optimize_pickups_deliveries, routific_submit_pickups_deliveries_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: routific_submit_route_job, routific_submit_pickups_deliveries_job · Public sink: routific_optimize_routes, routific_submit_route_job, routific_optimize_pickups_deliveries, routific_submit_pickups_deliveries_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
